reason: A browser UI utility that extracts LaTeX source from rendered formulas and lets users copy it in selectable inline or block formats.

summaries.zh: 在网页公式上悬停即可复制其 LaTeX 源码，并可选择美元符号或斜杠括号格式。
summaries.en: Copy the LaTeX source of rendered webpage formulas on hover, with selectable dollar-sign or slash-delimiter formats.

capabilities: Reads rendered KaTeX formula source from the current page DOM
Adds a hover-triggered copy button and format menu to the page UI
Writes selected LaTeX text to the browser clipboard after user interaction
